_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-vref-pvt on the `klt sim`
harness (issue #467, the bench behind the Output-reference nominal row
and the anchor every vref bench's sanity gate cites). The per-experiment
half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the
record MECHANICS and takes every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: Through the SAME co-simulated closed-loop topology sim/closed-loop-startup uses (bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup, carried verbatim from the design/netlist schematics and wired exactly as design/bandgap_top.sch specifies, real devices throughout, no ideal feedback fixture anywhere), vref's DC operating-point value across the full PVT grid, confirmed settled (|vref(3ms)-vref(2ms)| <= 1 mV, not merely a still-slewing transient snapshot) at a genuine closed-loop operating point (startup released, loop closed, fb not railed -- the four criteria sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh's pvt_closed_loop_verdict encodes, applied per point by sim/harness/enrich_pvt_report.py). The trim-bearing core rides at trim_code=128 (#229, refreshed by #264; solver convergence aids rshunt/gmin dropped -- see the README's 'Trim-bearing DUT refresh'). This is the schematic evidence the ratified Output-reference nominal row cites. Also computes an INFORMAL temperature coefficient (endpoint method, the -tc.csv companion) -- NOT a claim against a ratified TC row; also measures VBE(Q3) (v(cb3), same settledness rationale, issue #133) at every point.
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/closed-loop-vref-pvt/testbench/closed_loop_vref_pvt.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
